recommendations.title: Buy Minnesota Timberwolves to win
recommendations.matchup: San Antonio Spurs at Minnesota Timberwolves
recommendations.reason: Recommendation: buy Minnesota Timberwolves on the moneyline at home. Stripping the book's vig puts their fair win probability around 36%, and after adjusting for our home-court signal and historical bucket performance we estimate 39%. At +164 that is roughly +2.5% expected value per dollar, which is the threshold this model requires before flagging a side.
